BUCKET.CREATE.summary: Creates a new bucket with optional shard assignment and index definitions.
BUCKET.CREATE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of indexes in the schema.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to create.

arguments.name: shard-id
arguments.summary: One or more shard ids to place the bucket on. A shard is picked automatically when this is left out.

arguments.name: schema
arguments.summary: An index schema that defines the indexes created together with the bucket.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.summary: A bucket level collation spec for locale aware string ordering.

arguments.name: if-not-exists
arguments.summary: Reply with OK instead of an error when the bucket already exists.
